<thought>The monoisotopic mass of the neutral molecule is ≈99.045 Da (100.0524 m/z minus a proton). A formula C5H7O2 has a calculated monoisotopic mass of 99.0446 Da, matching the observed mass within experimental error. Its isotopic pattern (≈5.5 % M+1 from five carbons and ≈0.5 % M+2 from two 13C plus two 18O) aligns with the measured intensities. Therefore the molecular formula is C5H7O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C5H7O2</final_answer>
